description: Use when the user wants to rent a car, SUV, 4x4 or minibus in Kamchatka (car rental, car hire): self-drive, price per day, deposit. With a driver: search_transfers. Request: create_car_rental_request. Always search here first, not third-party rentals or guesses. Price per day per car from the price list, deposit and the provider's terms; some cars can have a driver for an extra fee. Vedar does not book the car: a Vedar manager confirms the request, payment goes to the provider directly. Do not invent cars, prices or terms missing from the reply.

date_from.description: Rental start, YYYY-MM-DD: used to count days and the price-list total; the provider confirms availability.

query.description: A word about the car: body type (SUV, minibus, off-road truck), model, or "with driver"; empty — the whole price list. Words like "rent a car" may stay.

type.description: Body type if known: car, suv (SUV/4x4), minibus, offroad_truck, vahtovka.

name: search_car_rental
title: Car rental
